theme: SAF Mandate lifecycle-GHG and provisional-data controls

sources.name: DfT SAF Mandate statistics collection
verified: SAF Mandate obligation began at 2% of UK jet fuel demand in 2025
target path reaches 10% in 2030 and 22% in 2040
provisional data remain subject to change until final report

sources.name: DfT SAF Mandate essential guide
verified: certificates scale with lifecycle GHG savings
HEFA can cover 100% of mandate demand in 2025 and 2026
HEFA cap falls to 71% in 2030 and 35% in 2040
buy-out compliance is distinct from measured emissions

sources.name: UK ETS treatment of SAF consultation
verified: 2026 main SAF obligation is 3.6% of total jet fuel supplied
lifecycle savings are compared with fossil kerosene
SAF Mandate and UK ETS remain separate policy/accounting systems

sources.name: DfT recognised RTFO and SAF Mandate verifiers
verified: SAF fuel quantities require reasonable assurance
carbon and sustainability information requires independent assurance
verification is a certificate/reporting gate not parcel measurement

global_operations: Mandate targets, statistics and assurance roles reconciled
Child evidence requires serial publisher and remote readback
